sections.name: GET
sections.title: Health check handler
sections.what: Reports the AI settings and runs a tiny test call, returning success or failure.
sections.why: Gives a fast way to see whether the AI setup works.
sections.watch_out: Shows part of the API key on a public address. Remove that detail or lock the route before wider use.

summary: Checks that the AI model responds and reports which AI settings are in use.
purpose: Lets the owner test the AI setup quickly.
why: Likely reason: a quick way to diagnose AI setup problems.
how: Reports whether the API key is set, showing its first six characters, sends a tiny test prompt, and returns status 200 if the test works or 500 if not.
outputs: A JSON report with the environment settings and the test result.
risks: Shows the first six characters of the API key to anyone who can reach this address, with no login check.
debug: MISSING means the key is not set on the server. The error field shows what the model call returned.
